papers.title: La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling
papers.authors: Mateo Clémente, George Z. Xue, Amin Abyaneh, Liheng Ma, Rui Heng Yang, Tongtong Cao, Zhanguang Zhang, Yingxue Zhang
papers.abstract: A compact world-action model trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. It predicts future features jointly with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. The paper reports strong RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus results and comparable performance to π0.5 on four real-robot tasks.
papers.contribution: Control-oriented latent world-action policy; contrasts JEPA features with video VAE latents and studies training-time future prediction choices.
papers.limitations: New preprint; results and baseline comparisons need independent reproduction. Verify benchmark instruction corrections and hardware conditions before drawing conclusions.
embodiments: robot manipulation; exact hardware variants should be checked in full text
papers.real_robot: Yes — four real-robot tasks are stated in the abstract.

papers.title: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
papers.abstract: VFlash predicts structured visual primitives such as points, boxes and variable-length trajectories jointly in one forward pass instead of autoregressively decoding coordinate tokens. Its authors report approximately 25× faster single-rollout generation for 3D point-motion forecasting and improved downstream WAM planning results.
papers.contribution: Primitive-aware flash decoding for structured spatial outputs, with type-, dimension- and length-adaptive layouts.
papers.limitations: Fast plan decoding does not by itself guarantee kinematic feasibility or closed-loop physical correctness. Validate end-to-end latency and physical execution separately.
embodiments: robot trajectory planning; specific hardware should be confirmed
